Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Diamond Shape Metal Frame Hanging Decorative Wall Mirror, 34.25 Inch Height, Gold Finish
Colors: Glass
Materials: metal
This mirror is a work of art, ready to make a modern style statement in your home. The gold finish of the layered diamond shapes gives it a 3D effect with a touch of glam, making it ideal for a modern style bedroom or living room. Modern design with touch of glam Glass, iron with gold finish 22.5W x 2"D x 34.25"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
